match.reason: The bank point teaches social justice principles for health promotion (equity, diversity, supportive environments), which is a different idea from the VCE Legal Studies principles of justice (fairness, equality, access) and would teach the wrong content.

draft.title: Principles of justice
card: the law uses fair processes. Decisions are made without bias, everyone gets a chance to be heard, and the process is open to scrutiny.
people are treated the same way. Where people start from different positions, different treatment can be needed so that each person gets a fair outcome.
a person can understand the legal system and use it. Cost, language, distance and not knowing their rights can all get in the way.
The three principles work together. A system is more just when its processes are fair, people are treated equally and people can reach it.
draft.remember: Justice asks three things: is the process fair, is treatment equal, and can people get into the system?

a.q: A court provides a free interpreter for a witness who speaks little English. Which principle is this mainly meant to meet?
opts: Access, so the person can understand and take part
Fairness, so the judge can be free of all bias
Equality, so every person is treated in the same way
Fairness, so the public can watch the hearing
a.why: An interpreter helps the witness understand the system and take part in it, which is access. Equality is the tempting option, but giving everyone identical treatment would leave this witness unable to follow the case.
a.clue: What stops this person from using the system?

b.q: A council holds a hearing about a new rule. Two residents are in wheelchairs, and the hearing room is only reachable by stairs. The council moves it to a ground-floor room. Which statement best explains this decision?
opts: Different treatment can be needed so each person is heard
Equality means everyone must always get the same treatment
Fairness only matters once a final decision has been made
Access is met once a hearing has been announced
b.why: Moving the room treats the residents differently so they can take part, which fits equality as the card describes it. The second option is tempting but wrong, because equality can mean different treatment where it is needed.
b.clue: Can equal treatment ever mean treating people differently?

a.best: Access, so the person can understand and take part

b.best: Different treatment can be needed so each person is heard

problems.detail: Distractors use absolute words ('only matters', 'must always') where the card says 'can'. This also makes them easy to rule out without knowing the idea.
The clue 'Can equal treatment ever mean treating people differently?' all but states the right option, so a student can answer without understanding the principle.
Why (b) calls 'the second option' the tempting wrong one, but options are shown in random order. The second option shown is 'Fairness only matters…', not the equality option the explanation means.

Moving a hearing out of a stairs-only room is a textbook physical-access barrier. Students may expect an access answer, while the intended answer is equality. The options settle it, but the scenario blurs the two principles.

b.q: Two people are found guilty of the same theft, done the same way, with no past offences. One is a wealthy business owner and one is unemployed. The magistrate gives both the same penalty. Why does this meet equality?
opts: People in the same position get the same treatment
Different treatment was given to meet each person's needs
Each person was given a chance to be heard in court
Both people were able to understand the court process
b.why: The two offenders are in the same position, and equality means the same treatment whatever a person's wealth or status. The option about different treatment is tempting, but that part of equality applies where people start from different positions, and these two did not.
b.clue: Does a person's wealth change how equality treats them?

a.best: Access, so the person can understand and take part

b.best: People in the same position get the same treatment
